main_body: A flat grass ground patch (about 36x16 px) with sparse darker green tufts and a few small red and yellow flower props. It is a terrain tile with no standing volume.
top_band: none; the column is a uniform mid green (#3a7e30) with occasional 1-row darker tuft pixels. There is no top band and no front face, as expected for flat ground.
evidence: The kind is terrain: a flat ground patch seen from above, so the 3/4 top-plus-front structure does not apply. There is no standing object, no side face and no elevation drawing. The column scan shows only a uniform grass tone with 1-row dark tuft flecks, which is consistent with ground texture. Nothing contradicts the terrain contract.

style.evidence: The candidate has only 8 distinct colours and a median of 8 per tile, against 26 per tile and 80 colours for the reference grass. Its flat-fill coverage is 22%, while the reference grass is at 0%. The main grass uses roughly three steps: a base green #3a7e30, a lighter #529a3a and a darker #2a642a. The scattered single-pixel tufts do not form clumps, and large areas of one identical green read as flat fill. The reference grass has layered blades, clumps and several greens. The candidate looks thinner and flatter next to it, and the few flower props do not make up the difference. It has no outline, which suits ground, but the texture and density are well below the Beodeul bar.
